newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 4.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Australian regulators on Thursday said they had begun an investigation into share trading in TNT Ltd just before the transport group received a friendly A$2.0 billion takeover bid from Dutch post and telecoms giant Koninklijke PTT Nederland (KPN). The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), which first took notice of trading in TNT options last week, said it regarded the matter very seriously and had asked the Australian Securities Commission to begin a formal investigation.

Hollinger International Inc officially ended the London broadsheet price war on Thursday, saying that its Daily Telegraph newspaper would hike its cover price starting next week, matching a recent increase by Rupert Murdoch's The Times. Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd joins the crowded television-news scramble in the U.S. with the launch on Monday of Fox News Channel, a 24-hour all-news cable channel.
Gelman Sciences Inc said Thursday its planned merger with Memtec Ltd hurt sales in the fourth quarter ended July 31, but some of the lost sales were recovered in August.

ICI Australia Ltd said on Thursday it could not explain the recent rise in its share price. The company also said in response to a query from the Australian Stock Exchange that it had also informed the market that its profit in the year to September 30 was likely to be below the 1994/95 result.

Westpac Banking Corp said on Friday its corporate finance division has won the role of financial adviser to Korea Zinc Australia for the financing of a A$1 billion zinc refinery project in Queensland.
